translation: When the middle region bounces left and right, it is the Belt Vessel; when it moves it causes lower abdominal pain drawing to the life gate, in women absence of menstruation, and after the line of succession is cut off it descends again, making one childless; in men, cramping of the lower abdomen, or seminal loss. When the rear region bounces left and right, it is the Yin Heel vessel; when it moves it causes mania-epilepsy with chills and fever, bi of the skin with stiffness, lower abdominal pain, internal urgency, pain connecting the lower back and hip, in men yin hernia, in women incessant leaking. When [the pulse] goes obliquely from the Lesser Yin to the Greater Yang, it is the Yang Linking (wei) vessel; when it moves it causes falling with sheep-like bleating, hands and feet drawing each other, and in severe cases loss of voice with inability to speak, and bi with itching of the flesh.
